CRL.M.A. 6489/2023 (for correction in order dated 05.12.2022)

1. This application has been filed seeking corrections in order dated 5th December, 2022 passed by this Court vide which the petition filed by the petitioner seeking quashing of FIR No.95/2015 under sections 498A/ 406/34 IPC PS CAW Cell Nanakpura was allowed on the ground that the disputing parties had settled their disputes through mediation.
Details are recorded in the said order.
However, in para No.3 of the said order, it has been incorrectly noted that "as the complainant has settled all disputes and received the settled amounts from the petitioner".

A perusal of mediation settlement would however show that there was no one-time amount which was to be paid, but in fact Hardeep Singh Yadav & Ors vs State Gnct Of Delhi & Anr on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110325891/

sentences.text: 1 there was commitment by the petitioner no.1 of paying monthly maintenance of Rs.4,500/- on 15th of every month to the complainant- respondent no.2, as recorded in the said settlement.
It is informed by the learned counsel for the respondent no.2 that both the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 are now living together as husband and wife along with their children in harmony.
2. Petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2-complainant are present in the Court and have been duly identified by the IO and their respective counsels.
3. In view of the same the part of the sentence in para 3 viz. "as the complainant has settled all disputes and received the settled amounts from the petitioner", is accordingly deleted.

4. Application stands disposed of.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
